tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galley National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

My favorite food is a smothered bean and cheese burrito from La Frontera in Salt Lake City. I no longer live there, so I don't get to eat it much anymore, which makes me very sad. Sometimes I dream about their chile verde. I really miss it.
